handlers: showcase submit: commit drafts, validate, Busy(23) countdown, Done with status
showcase invalid: focus the first invalid field, keep errors visible; Reset rebuilds defaults
jackin FormDialog: ring traversal, hidden skip, Esc cancel, commit sets dirty and Changed(name)
tablepro ConnForm: name/port validators gate Save; Test runs without saving
thresholds: SUBMIT_TICKS = 23; name needs 4+ chars; port is 1-65535 or empty
inner below 11 rows or 40 cols renders nothing; below 17 rows the area compacts to 1 row
timers: submit countdown: one Tick per count; Done exactly at zero
early_returns: invalid submit returns before busy; tiny inner area returns; hidden fields are skipped in traversal
notes: Ctrl+S submits from anywhere on the showcase page; child TextInput/TextArea/Select semantics are untouched

handlers: open(step): build the step modal from retained values
on_modal: advance on Ok results, reopen the step on validation errors, rewind on cancel
rewind: previous step by chain order with the Edit skip; Source cancels to the Manager
create: pending workspace from source, destination, and name
thresholds: five fixed steps; choice dialog width 58, prompt width 62, workdir picker width 72 with 8 rows max
timers: none: the wizard has no timer; child feedback owns its ticks
early_returns: Destination without a source and Workdir without a destination return; create without the triple returns
notes: stepper shows ✓ for past steps and 'Edit skipped' when choice 0 bypassed Edit; every rewind restores cwd, dest_text, and name
